tests.name: release dry run rejects missing verification evidence
complete release checklist is review-ready without authorization
incident dry runs require containment confirmation
migration and rollback cannot omit data compatibility

criteria.requirement: No silent failure, secrets in artifacts, unapproved egress or bypass of human approval.
criteria.reason: Checklist data model is offline and never authorizes execution; end-to-end runtime egress, secret scanning, diagnostics and human approval require separate validation.

criteria.requirement: CI and relevant tests green with documented reproduction commands.
criteria.reason: Reproduction commands are documented; successful exact-head GitHub CI and any applicable native checks must be observed before certification.
